verdict.rationale: x402 supports agent-driven payments via MCP-compatible tool calls and a Bazaar MCP server that exposes payable merchant endpoints to "tens of thousands of agents," which is the mechanism by which an assistant surface could discover and pay for a merchant's product mid-conversation. However, there is no evidence of concrete integration with named chat/assistant products (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) — the MCP support is generic, not confirmed live inside these specific surfaces. Missing for 10: named-platform integrations/case studies (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot), evidence of end-user checkout UX inside those chat surfaces rather than raw agent/API-to-API payment flow.
